style: Cinematic 3D animated movie still, Pixar-meets-photoreal style, highly detailed skin and fabric textures, dramatic warm golden lighting, dark luxury color palette (black, burgundy, gold), shallow depth of field, anthropomorphic fruit- and vegetable-headed characters, vertical 9:16 composition, no text except the glowing forehead displays

music.description: Brazilian funk / batida beat, about 130 BPM, punchy tamborzão drums, deep 808 bass, playful and confident, no vocals

MO.name: Mo (Mandarine)
MO.prompt: a skinny young man in his twenties whose entire head is a shiny orange mandarin with a small green leaf and stem on top, dimpled peel texture, big hopeful brown eyes, expressive eyebrows, a red glowing digital LED display embedded in his forehead showing "{display}", wearing a worn faded orange hoodie, grey sweatpants and old white sneakers
MO.voice_note: aufgeregt, ungläubig, schnell (Stimme B aus dem Vergleich)

MO_RICH.name: Mo – reiches Outfit (gleiche Stimme wie Mo)
MO_RICH.prompt: a skinny young man in his twenties whose entire head is a shiny orange mandarin with a small green leaf and stem on top, dimpled peel texture, big excited brown eyes, a red glowing digital LED display embedded in his forehead showing "{display}", wearing a white designer tracksuit, a thick gold chain, a gold watch and brand-new white sneakers

KARL.name: Karl (Gurke)
KARL.prompt: a tall calm young man whose entire head is a long bumpy green cucumber, half-closed bored eyes, flat unimpressed mouth, a red glowing digital LED display embedded in his forehead showing "{display}", wearing a black beanie, a black hoodie and a dark green kiosk apron
KARL.voice_note: tief, trocken, monoton (Stimme A aus dem Vergleich)

JESSY.name: Jessy (Kirsche, Ex-Freundin)
JESSY.prompt: a glamorous young woman whose entire head is a glossy dark red cherry with a stem and a green leaf on top like a hair accessory, long eyelashes, glossy lips, a red glowing digital LED display on her forehead showing "{display}", wearing a tight pink designer dress, oversized sunglasses pushed up, a flashy designer handbag and high heels
JESSY.voice_note: frech, zuckersüß gespielt (Stimme B aus dem Lara-Vergleich)

LILA.name: Dr. Lila (Aubergine, Vermögensberater)
LILA.prompt: a slick middle-aged man whose entire head is a glossy purple eggplant with the green calyx on top styled like slicked-back hair, thin moustache, too-perfect white smile, gold-rimmed glasses, a red glowing digital LED display on his forehead showing "{display}", wearing a navy pinstripe suit, burgundy tie, gold cufflinks, carrying a black leather briefcase

KALLE.name: Onkel Kalle (Kokosnuss)
KALLE.prompt: a loud chubby man in his fifties whose entire head is a hairy brown coconut, huge grin with a gold tooth, a red glowing digital LED display on his forehead showing "{display}", wearing a loud Hawaiian shirt, a fake gold chain, cargo shorts and flip flops

ZITRONE.name: Kommissarin Zitrone
ZITRONE.prompt: a strict woman in her forties whose entire head is a bright yellow lemon, sharp narrow eyes, a red glowing digital LED display on her forehead showing "{display}", wearing a dark navy police uniform with a gold badge

locations.KIOSK: small cramped late-night German kiosk with neon light, shelves full of snacks and drinks, a glowing LOTTO sign in the window, rainy street outside
locations.STRASSE: front of a run-down grey apartment block in the morning, a crowd of curious fruit-headed people with phones gathered at the door
locations.PENTHOUSE: huge luxury penthouse at night with floor-to-ceiling windows over a glowing city skyline, a turquoise pool built right into the living room, gold and black marble interior
locations.PARTY: the same luxury penthouse during a wild party, purple and gold party lights, champagne towers, many dancing fruit-headed guests
locations.YACHT: deck of a huge white superyacht on a dark sea at sunset, white leather lounge, champagne bucket, laptop on a table
